goal: Review the focused follow-up to pushed commit 3b53a0f: stdin-only private review context, a minimal reviewer environment, and the owner's explicit Sonnet default selection, preserving execution/integrity behavior and accurate historical evidence.

acceptance.description: Complete review context is delivered as exactly one valid stdin user frame followed by EOF, with no prompt/source content in command arguments. Delivery errors, early input closure, timeout and process failure cannot produce PASS or hang the runner.

Reviewer runs and CLI help probes use an explicit environment allowlist that drops application/provider/CI secrets and preload hooks while preserving needed runtime, cached sign-in/configuration, proxy/CA and supported credential-file settings. Parent environment and repository-check behavior remain unchanged.

Existing model pin, denied-action detection, bounded execution, source/snapshot integrity and cached-result validation remain intact. Regression tests and documentation accurately describe the hardening, authentication assumptions, execution boundaries and verification scope; no application or dependency changes are introduced.

The owner-approved default is claude-sonnet-4-6 (Sonnet 4.6 Thinking), configuration and current guidance agree, and actual CLI-reported selection must match. Historical Opus results and the quota-interrupted INCOMPLETE run keep their original attribution; no automatic model fallback is introduced.
